description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Quad Element Mode (Ice, Lightning, Wind, Water)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Arciela], [Naakual's Vengeance Damage Tracker] and [Naakual's Vengeance Level]

description.name: Quad Element Mode (Ice, Lightning, Wind, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Wind]/[Attach Water] after using a Ice/Lightning/Wind/Water ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Arciela
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Naakual's Vengeance (0~2), removed after using Naakual's Vengeance two times

description.name: Naakual's Vengeance Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Naakual's Vengeance level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Arciela]

description.name: Naakual's Vengeance Level
description.text: Keeps track of Naakual's Vengeance level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Arciela]
